description: This file defines the MyReviewMenuConfigurator class, which implements the MenuConfigurator interface. Its purpose is to configure menu items related to employee performance reviews within the OrangeHRM performance module. It uses traits and classes from the OrangeHRM framework to override the screen for the performance review menu item.

classes.name: MyReviewMenuConfigurator
classes.description: Implements menu configuration for performance review menu items, specifically to override screens for 'myPerformanceReview'.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Overrides the screen for the current module to 'myPerformanceReview'.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Configures the menu item by overriding the current screen to 'myPerformanceReview'.
